name: LaBeau's (Garden City, UT) Classic BLT on Toasted White Bread (Peeled Tomato Mod)
whyItWorks: A classic summer diner sandwich. Crispy bacon provides salt and flavor without heavy spices. Shredded iceberg lettuce is soft and low-fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the BLT on toasted white bread with mayo; ask to hold tomato slices if sensitive to acidity.
watchOuts: Tomato skins can occasionally be acidic during flareups
